REVIEW_FILE=".github/mizizi-track-production-review.json"

  printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED"

fi

echo "MIZIZI_EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.run:

case "$EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA" in
  [0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]) ;;
  *)
    echo "STOP: expected_main_sha must be a full lowercase commit SHA."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

git fetch origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
git switch -C main refs/remotes/origin/main

test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "main"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA"

steps.name: Require exact reviewed pending set
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

EXPECTED="$(
  printf '%s\n' "$EXPECTED_PENDING" |
    tr ',' '\n' |
    sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' |
    sed '/^$/d' |
    sort -u
)"

test -n "$EXPECTED"

while IFS= read -r name; do
  case "$name" in
    [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.sql) ;;
    *)
      echo "STOP: non-canonical expected migration filename: $name"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
  test -f "supabase/migrations/$name"
done <<EOF
$EXPECTED
EOF

DRY="$(
  supabase db push --dry-run --linked 2>&1
)"
printf '%s\n' "$DRY"

ACTUAL="$(
  {
    printf '%s\n' "$DRY" |
      grep -Eo '[0-9]{14}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.sql' || true
  } |
    sort -u
)"

if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
  printf 'STOP: pending migration set changed.\nEXPECTED:\n%s\nACTUAL:\n%s\n'               "$EXPECTED" "$ACTUAL"
  exit 1
fi

echo "REPOSITORY_MIGRATION_EXACT_PENDING_SET=PASS"

steps.name: Record zero-pending completion
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

POST="$(
  supabase db push --dry-run --linked 2>&1
)"
printf '%s\n' "$POST"

POST_PENDING="$(
  {
    printf '%s\n' "$POST" |
      grep -Eo '[0-9]{14}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.sql' || true
  } |
    sort -u
)"

test -z "$POST_PENDING"

echo "REPOSITORY_MIGRATION_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION=PASS"
